fields.Name: T111 - AI Overview Dashboard
fields.Description: Verifies the AI app Overview loads with its quick-stats strip and navigation cards via the application switcher.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), and land on the AI Overview. Confirm the Overview renders with its hero/quick-stats strip showing counts for Active Agents, Models, Prompts, and Vendors, plus the navigation cards. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app Overview is displayed with a quick-stats strip showing labeled counts (Active Agents, Models, Prompts, Vendors)
Navigation cards for AI sections are visible on the Overview
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
